summary: No concrete remaining security or logic finding within the implemented M1/M2 scope. Both initial findings are resolved: receive-side FIN no longer cancels a valid half-closed request, and models construction, append, and serialization failures return generic errors without partial success or NULL serialization reaching reply(). Model-rewrite string/set failures also stop before dispatch. The test shim genuinely targets these API failure-return seams, preserves Jansson ownership, and proves one-shot injection through its consumed arm file and exact marker; it is not exhaustive internal allocator testing. Current classifier logic scans numeric/boolean/null scalars, fails closed on scanning failures, preserves stronger or unknown provider restrictions by routing privately rather than removing them, reclassifies final public controls, and retains already-private physical models. Fresh independent container build and all 25 focused allocation, transport-safety, and compliance tests passed. Half-close response integrity, prompt idle-RST and busy-stream cancellation, and deadline-bounded ambiguous FIN behavior were exercised without synthetic heartbeat bytes. Verification used disabled external networking, read-only source and container root, and disposable /tmp build artifacts. No repository files, configuration, Git state, or services were modified; no secrets, raw traces, or live inference were accessed. Sanitizer verification remains with the parent agent.
